acceptanceCriteria: Reuse happens only on an exact tree id match with a successful required check for the same workflow file blob and toolchain identity; anything else runs in full.
The reused run id and tree id are retained as an artifact.
The fraction of main commits with a completed or reused result is reported before and after.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 during a CI audit (Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Tasks build 202) at origin/main e5d47da8; hosted run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/37198363933 (4 shards, 295 packages, 5635s summed package time, race steps 1924/1647/1397/1264s). Idea. Every merge to main reruns the full 33-minute suite, and 30 of the last 65 main push runs were cancelled by cancel-in-progress, so about half of main commits have no completed CI result of their own. When the pushed commit's tree id equals the tree of a PR merge ref that already passed go-product under the same workflow and runner identity, the result is evidence for the same immutable content. Proposal: a trusted first job compares tree ids and records the reused run; otherwise run in full. Separately decide whether main pushes should queue instead of cancel so each merge keeps a result. Related: CORE-GITHUB-MERGE-QUEUE-COMPATIBILITY-1.

completion.reason: V1-0717 delivered by beamfall/corvint#530, merge commit 6bf78ff76889519d43b34cc2a5dfbf42b72e9ba9, with required checks green; full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN under the owner's standing scoped-work preference in AGENTS.md, manual disposition on focused tests, hosted required checks and independent review; evidence digests are sha256 of these files at that commit: 6bf78ff7:docs/build-log/2026-10-04-ci-main-push-reuse.md 06b4c1edbfab9980a2048d26567a2150becc099daea7ebe2fe400b5feb86cf17; 6bf78ff7:tools/ci-reuse-plan/main.go 44b6dcb3d2f86de56ef909e96f9b79695270da722f6d7b9da6c2c8eea9b03e07; 6bf78ff7:tools/ci-reuse-plan/main_test.go 49d8a356733087dcaba894cd58b32806590cf554c7474c19ca0a89d58b72fdf9; 6bf78ff7:.github/workflows/ci.yml d9978dad7ebcb4eaee8145a7a2618255689804e8108f5c5db4f33f5bba3c411d. AC1: tools/ci-reuse-plan admits reuse only on an exact tree id match with a successful required run for the same workflow file blob and toolchain identity and otherwise plans FULL (main_test.go). AC2: hosted artifact ci-reuse of main run 37226447115 (a5bb0d8f) records mode REUSE, tree bf1e8a842af7e88e7f37b9a39510bdffce8fe987, runId 37223142436 and four ci-tested-tree records; runs 37222991297 and 37232903314 record mode FULL with the reason. AC3: main push CI runs with a completed or reused result: before (2026-10-02T02:33Z to 2026-10-04T16:39Z) 20 of 39, none reused; after (from merge 6bf78ff7, 2026-10-04T16:43Z to 20:38Z) 3 of 21, one reused, the rest cancelled by newer pushes during heavy merge traffic; the after window is short and does not show an improvement.

title: ci: reuse a passed PR result on the main push when the merged tree is byte-identical to the tested merge
